description: Using form17 and command11 or96, hold the center seam quiet while ringing the outside pair. Read the negative space on a mural, not a memorized color order.
Using form26 and command23 or24, bank a visible seed arc through the unshaded side of two scaffold windows, then raise the resulting branch span. All ledges have foot access.
Using form23 and command15 or16, choose two warm stops from a pictured three-stop route while a manual hood keeps the third occupied shelter warm. No timed heat loss.
Using form101 and command102, listen at two hinge faces without drawing the marked counterweight; walk through the quiet gap and latch it from the other side.
Using form20 and command13 or14, tie the far slack line first, reel the low load around the occupied walkway, then release only the empty tie. No pushing movable crates.
Using form103 and command104, float the skiff, select the wider illustrated landing, walk by the bank to receive it, then reconnect the return wake. Passenger is never lost or harmed.
Using form29 and command25 or26, clear the shallow outer spillway before the central one, as shown by ground slope arrows, preserving the dry root bed. Reset re-silts only this local attempt.
Using form16 and command11, strike the open face of three marked clappers after manually choosing quiet or ringing. Sound has a synchronized shape flash; hearing is never required.
Using form8 and command3 or7, stop the sail at its middle pennant, walk under the cleared boom, then release toward the return mooring. The brake can be set before movement.
Using form5 and command2 or6, grow the two perimeter roots while leaving the marked drain gap clear. Raise a manual guide board to move the waiting sapling trolley through the opening.
Using form2 and command1 or5, warm the occupied hearth before the empty one; manual shutters visibly route surplus away from cloth. Player chooses order, not reaction timing.
Using form11 and command4 or8, press the side support, walk a weighted wheeled stone through the open lintel, then transfer the support without sealing the pedestrian exit.
Using form14 and command9 or10, choose the long illustrated current around living reeds, transfer the float, and reconnect the return pool. A wrong route drains back without losing cargo.
Reopen the visible three-part canopy shade route from opposite ends without obscuring the caretaker's exit.
Route one beam through three labeled demonstration receivers across two freely resettable configurations.
Trace three drawn drainage branches and clear marked caps before the visible overflow shortcut; RESET safely drains incorrect settings.
Release three paired catches without closing the worker's access lane; reset handles remain outside every catch.
Restore three separately drawn root supports from different reachable ledges in rooms 31 and 32.
Preview the three sources of a cloudy runnel and clear their visible leaf catches; incorrect catches are harmless and reversible.
Use three drying stations while preserving each cloth's visible safe moisture band; wrong settings reset freely.
Light three marked line-of-sight beacons while protecting the cloth screens; RESET restores a wrong arrangement.
Hold one pressure plate and turn two linked shutters while preserving a walkable loop and reachable return handle.
Align three shallow ore inspection sockets into a route diagram while leaving its central walking gap open.
Complete the five-phase relay, then survive 90 active-play seconds using two opposite-polarity support switches; failure resets only the trial.
